question: Who among the following was an initial member of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. KM Munshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanhaiyalal Maneklal Munshi **served on the committee that **B. R. Ambedkar chaired to create the Indian Constitution **as well as the ad hoc Flag Committee that chose the country's flag in August 1947.
 
• Munshi, also known by his pen name Ghanshyam Vyas, was a Gujarati writer, politician, and activist for Indian independence. Originally a lawyer, he eventually became a politician and novelist. His name is widely recognized in Gujarati literature.
 
• In 1938, he established the educational trust Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan.
 
• From 1952 to 1957, Munshi served over Uttar Pradesh as governor.
 
• Munshi founded the Akhand Hindustan movement in 1959 after severing ties with the Nehru-led, socialist Congress Party. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Benegal Narsing Rau** was an Indian statesman, jurist, civil servant, and diplomat who played a significant part in writing the country's constitution. He served as the Constituent Assembly's constitutional advisor.
 
• Indian politician **Tiruvellore Thattai Krishnamachari** held the position of Finance Minister twice, from 1956 to 1958 and 1964 to 1966.
 
• In addition to serving as the 23rd dewan of Mysore from 1941 to 1945, **Sir Nyapathi Madhava Rau **was an Indian civil servant, administrator, and statesman. He also participated in the Constituent Assembly's Drafting Committee, which was tasked with creating the Indian Constitution.
